summary: A BofA AI bubble warning, CoreWeave credit stress, and VIX spiking above 22 triggered a four-session, $260B+ risk-off unwind crushing high-multiple AI, cloud, and crypto names (PLTR, SNOW -8%+, MSTR -9.6% with added MSCI removal headwinds, MARA -9.6%). Capital rotated decisively into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.6%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%) on Middle East escalation via Yemen missile strikes and a US SPR solicitation, while AAPL held as the lone resilient core-tech name on iPhone demand, Chinese subsidies, and Berkshire support. Core calls — **BUY RTX, LMT, AAPL; SELL PLTR, MSTR** — remained fully intact across all sessions.

**Week Summary (3 sentences):**

AI/cloud and cybersecurity (DDOG, NET, AMZN) were the dominant BUY themes, fueled by SpaceX compute demand, PHP vulnerability spikes, and Iran escalation-driven infrastructure bids — with NET and DDOG delivering strong gains — though the Nasdaq's worst session since June, triggered by chipmaking supply warnings and META AI spending fears, crushed semis (AMD -8.1%, INTC -8.0%) and pulled the broader growth complex below its 50-day MA. Defense was a major early-week driver via NOC's $110B backlog, LMT's ~7% F-35 surge, and RTX read-across BUYs, but geopolitical risk-premium fading and Ukraine peace talk resumption sparked a late-week rotation out of the sector, while capital shifted defensively into cybersecurity and energy infrastructure as Iran escalation entered day two. MSTR and PLTR SELLs were badly burned (-12.2% and -8.4%) by crypto regulatory clarity and the AI rebound, AAPL was downgraded on foldable sell-the-news risk, and AMZN BUY was closed at -5.5% and flipped to SELL ahead of earnings — leaving NET (+6.0%), DDOG (+3.6%), and LMT (+2.4%) as the week's cleanest working calls.

**Summary:** AI infrastructure euphoria rapidly reversed into a sector-wide reckoning — early BUY validation from ORCL, Azure, and Anthropic's IPO gave way to INTC's -28.6% collapse, GOOGL's worst-ever single-day drop (-12.6%) on structural search fears, and broad semi weakness (NVDA, AMD, AVGO, DDOG all deeply underwater), leaving the Nasdaq on pace for its worst month in over a year. Capital rotated decisively into Defense (LHX +6.84%, RTX, LMT outperforming on $11B missile awards and DoD spending), Energy (XOM, CVX bid up on Hormuz tanker fires and Saudi evacuation orders), and Consumer Staples (WMT), while Big Tech earnings sharply divided the tape with AMZN on WATCH amid AI capex overhang. Key active calls are BUY LHX, RTX, LLY; high-conviction SELL GOOGL and META; a hawkish Fed hold at 3.75–4.0% and tighter sell discipline on AI longs represent the principal forward risks.

**Summary:** The two-week period was dominated by extreme semiconductor volatility — an initial brutal chip selloff (MU -17.5%, AMD -17.3%, TSM -10.8%) driven by AI spending fears and regulation concerns was followed by a sharp rebound (AMD +11%, TSM +6.3%) confirming AI capex demand remains intact, while mega-cap tech (MSFT, AAPL) and post-election defensives lagged the recovery. Key calls saw AMZN emerge as the standout long (+8.3%), PLTR SELL extend gains to +11.6%, AMD BUY cut at -16.4% loss, and MSFT BUY exited on a fresh negative catalyst, with NVDA re-entered at oversold levels into the bounce. Overall portfolio conviction remains cautious with a challenged 47%/33% win rate, as cloud earnings risk (DDOG -14.4%) and ongoing sector rotation complexity continue to pressure execution.

**Weekly Summary (2 Weeks)**

Markets whipsawed between a broad risk-on surge (Dow +1,100+) driving semiconductor and AI gains — AMD +13.3% on a Google Cloud win, NET +9.3% on a strong earnings beat, AVGO +8.8% — and a subsequent risk-off reversal triggered by a hotter-than-expected CPI print reigniting 50bps Fed hike fears, with NVDA the standout loser across both weeks (-4.3% then -5.5%) after a CEO governance probe prompted a SELL flip. Defensives (LMT +2.5%) and crypto (MARA +10.5%) diverged from the broader tech selloff, while NET/TSM showed resilience on fundamentals versus COIN's underperformance highlighting exchange-specific rate sensitivity. Key discipline takeaways: require multi-source confirmation before entering BUY signals, treat leadership/governance risk as an immediate exit trigger, and size down high-multiple AI names into yield-surge environments.
